name: dsa-arcade
description: DSA Arcade — Learn DSA by Playing It. Monorepo root.

scripts.build: npm --workspace @dsa/shared run build && npm --workspace @dsa/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @dsa/shared run typecheck && npm --workspace @dsa/api run typecheck && npm --workspace @dsa/web run typecheck && npm --workspace @dsa/runner run typecheck
scripts.runner:up: docker build -t dsa-cpp-sandbox:dev -f packages/runner/sandbox.Dockerfile packages/runner && docker compose up -d --build runner runner-gateway
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:up && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
